issues.title: Malawi declares all-out war on international crime gangs as Minister Mukhito vows: ‘We will not surrender’
issues.title_en: Malawi declares all-out war on international crime gangs as Minister Mukhito vows: ‘We will not surrender’
issues.summary: Malawi has declared an all-out war on organised crime, with the government unveiling plans for a tough new national strategy to tackle increasingly sophisticated criminal networks operating across borders.
